tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rab rin po che rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa bsam pa lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs// na mo mañju gho ṣa ya/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum rnams/ /'gro ba'i don du rigs gsum skur bstan pa'i/ /rnam sprul rgyun chad med par byon pa'i rgyud/ /sa skya'i gdung rab rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /spyi rings g.yu rings g.yu se ma bzang bdun/ /dpa' bo stag dang stag po 'od can dang / /g.ya' spangs skyes gcig 'khon bar skyes nyid mtshan/ /dpal po che dang khri mdzes lha legs zhabs/ /tshe lha dbang phyug klu yi dbang po dang / /tshe 'dzin rdo rje rin chen 'bro tsha bdun/ /shes rab yon tan yon tan 'byung gnas zhabs/ /tshul khrims rgyal po gtsug tor shes rab mtshan/ /dge skyabs dge mthong 'khon ston bal po dang / /shākya blo gros shes rab tshul khrims zhabs/ /dkon mchog rgyal po sa chen kun snying mtshan/ /kun dga' 'bar dang rtse mo grags pa'i zhabs/ /dpal chen 'od po chos rje sa paṇa dang / /zang tsha bsod rgyal dpal ldan 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /'gro mgon phyag na slob dpon rin rgyal ba/ /slob dpon ye 'byung dharmā pā la dang / /rat+na bha dra bdag nyid chen po'i zhabs/ /bsod nams bzang po rat+na shrī dang / /ti shrī kun blo'i bar byon gdan sa ches/ /spyi la dbang rgyur gdung rab rim byon dang / /de nas mkhas btsun chen po nam mkha' legs/ /nam mkha' bshes gnyen gug shrī nam mkha' rgyal/ /ta dben kun rin blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /grags pa blo gros kun dga' blo gros mtshan/ /kun dga' dbang phyug bar du rim byon pa'i/ /bzhi thog bla brang skyongs mdzad gdung rab dang / /de nas ta dben kun dga' nyi ma dang / /'jam dbyangs don rgyal 'gro mgon bsod nams mtshan/ /nyi ma rgyal mtshan bla chen kun rgyal ba/ /'jam dbyangs nam rgyal mthu stobs dbang phyug dang / /rgya gar sher bzang blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs/

/grags pa rgyal mtshan bar du legs byon pa'i/ /bla brang rin chen sgang pa'i gdung rab dang / /gzhan yang ti shrī kun dga' legs pa dang / /ti shrī kun rgyal slob dpon chos rgyal mtshan/ /ta dben blo rgyal theg chen chos rje'i zhabs/ /dharma dh+wa dza rdo rje rin chen dang / /bsod nams bkra shis bde legs bkra shis zhabs/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan shākya seṅge dang / /don grub rgyal mtshan bsam grub rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /kun bkras kun rgyal kun dga' snying po'i mtshan/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / /kun dga' legs pa'i bar du byon pa yi/ /lha khang bla brang pa yi gdung rab dang / /gzhan yang slob dpon chen po nyi ma dpal/ /kun dga' legs rgyal bla chen bsod blo dang / /dbang gi mtshan gsol grags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /slob dpon kun legs rnam sras rgyal mtshan dbang / /'jam dbyangs chos rgyal kun dga' blo gros dang / /nam mkha' legs pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /nam mkha' rin chen nam mkha' bkra shis mtshan/ /kun dga' bsod nams ngag gi dbang phyug dang / /'jam dpal grags pa tshe brtan bkra shis zhabs/ /kun dga' bsam grub kun dga' bde legs dang / /bsod nams lhun grub hor sog bsod rgyal ba/ /'jig rten rgya hor de sras rnam pa gsum/ /da lta gzhung pa'i gdung brgyud mched gnyis ste/ /rtse gdong phyogs su chad pa'i gdung rab dang / /kun dga' bsam grub gcung po sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed ngag dbang kun rin dang / /bsod nams dbang po grags pa blo gros mtshan/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug kun dga' dbang rgyal dang / /ngag dbang kun bsod bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs/ /kun dga' bkra shis mched gsum la sogs pa'i/ /da lta byon dang ma 'ong sras mtha'i bar/ /'byon par nges pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /gdung rab rim par byon pa thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/

/de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag gi 'di dang phyi ma'i don thams cad/ /yid la re ba ji bzhin lhun grub te/ /bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /ces dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rab rin po che rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa bsam pa lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang chos med snyoms las mkhan za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis phag lo zla ba lnga'i dmar cha'i tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal ldan kun dga' tshe ring gis bgyis so/ /'dis kyang bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rabs rin po che rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa bsam pa lhun grub/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
